items.name: Life Groups
items.description: Small groups meet throughout the week in homes across Steinbach. Where deep friendships are built and real life gets lived.

items.name: Harvest (50+)
items.description: Golden years, golden community. Gatherings for fellowship, shared meals, trips, and good conversation.

items.name: Men's Ministry
items.description: First Saturday of every month — fellowship, food, and board games at the church. Just show up.

items.name: Women's Ministry
items.description: Tuesday mornings, 9–11 AM. Study, prayer, and community. Part of our morning is spent in the prayer room.

items.name: Young Adults
items.description: Finding your way in your 20s? A place to ask hard questions and grow in faith with people who get it.

items.name: Youth Group
items.description: For teens who are ready to explore faith on their own terms. Fun, honest, and real.
